messages:
maria: Heads up — CI scanner workers OOMing on main after the last dependency bump, causing a pileup of Snyk webhooks. Seen ~120 failed scan jobs in the last hour. Logs attached below.
maria: ```runtime: out of memory\ngoroutine 1 [running]:\nmain.scan() /src/scanner/scan.go:142\n```
ops-bot: CI job failed: scan-worker-992 (link: https://ci.internal/jobs/scan-worker-992) :x:
samir: ugh. did we change the scanner service account RBAC or quotas recently? volume mounts? @jon any infra changes last night?
jon: I rotated a KMS key for archived artifacts at 03:20 UTC but I didn't touch RBAC. The key rotation should be transparent, but I'll double-check grants for `scanner-sa`.
sec-oncall: OOMs + webhook backlog = denial of scanning capacity. Two things to triage: 1) why each worker OOMs (large archives?), 2) why Snyk/GHAS webhooks keep dispatching instead of being rate-limited.
maria: reproducer: a single repo with huge `node_modules` tar (~1.4GB) triggers decompression spike and memory blowup. Scanner currently streams to disk then extracts fully in memory.
samir: can we switch to streaming extraction or limit concurrency? quick mitigation: drop concurrent workers and disable full extraction for certain languages.
maria: proposed emergency patch (will open PR): set env `SCANNER_MAX_CONCURRENCY=2` and `SCANNER_STREAM_EXTRACT=true`, and add an allowlist to skip `node_modules` extraction for JS scans. snippet:
```
# deploy config
- name: SCANNER_MAX_CONCURRENCY
  value: "2"
- name: SCANNER_STREAM_EXTRACT
  value: "true"
- name: SCANNER_SKIP_PATHS
  value: "**/node_modules/**"
```
jon: agree to the env change. I'll push a hotfix deploy now. Also investigating KMS grants: if the scanner can't decrypt old artifacts it might re-run scans which could amplify load.
ci-bot: Deploy started: scanner-worker hotfix (deploy/678) by jon — https://ci.internal/deploys/678 :rocket:
maria: for longer-term: switch to incremental scanning (tar streaming + on-the-fly file hashing) and add an upper bound on extracted bytes per repo.
samir: also add a Snyk webhook debounce/backoff in the scanner-orchestrator: when we see >5 failures from same repo in 10m, pause retries for 30m. That should drain the queue.
sec-oncall: +1 to both. We should also add an alert: `scanner.worker.oom.count > 0` and `snyk.webhook.queue.length > 50` with pager to oncall.
jon: KMS note: rotation left principal `service-account:scanner-sa@redwood.internal` in place, but the role binding for `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt` was missing on one project. Granting now.
jon: granted KMS decrypt on archived artifacts project. If you still see decrypt errors, ping me with an example artifact id.
maria: hotfix deploy succeeded, rolling restarts started. early signs: webhook queue dropping, one worker still OOMed after processing that 1.4GB tar — will patch scanner binary to stream decompress.
samir: I'll open the orchestrator debounce PR and add the 30m pause policy. assigning to @samir for PR and to @maria to add the stream-decompress change.
sec-oncall: postmortem checklist: root cause = full extraction of huge archives + lack of debounce on webhooks; contributing = missing KMS role in one project which caused re-runs. Remediation: stream extraction, concurrency cap, webhook backoff, KMS role audit. Who wants to own?
maria: I'll own the extractor change and metrics+alerting. samir owns orchestrator debounce. jon owns KMS audit script.
sec-oncall: thanks. please put short runbook steps in the security playbook: emergency env flip for `SCANNER_MAX_CONCURRENCY` and `SCANNER_STREAM_EXTRACT`.
maria: putting runbook in PR now. quick note: include `--skip-extraction-pattern "**/node_modules/**"` for immediate relief.
samir: OK will follow up with PR links. :thumbsup:
jon: all good here, will monitor KMS logs and confirm no more decrypt failures.
maria: closing thread when alerts stabilize. thx everyone. :pray:
